purpose: establish learnability of predictive service-chain reconfiguration after separating high-level service intent from shared 3DOF execution

policy_interface.shared_execution: deterministic role-conditioned controller maps only public waypoints and own state to the unchanged 27 primitive 3DOF actions

decision_rule: If at least two seeds obtain non-zero bounded service value at the terminal pilot validation, expand the same plain-MAPPO interface to the full baseline budget before adding PSCR-specific learning mechanisms.
interpretation_boundary: Development-only task-interface calibration; it is not a formal method comparison.
